newsitem.title: FRANCE: MOTOR RACING-AYARI ESCAPES INJURY AFTER CRASH.
newsitem.headline: MOTOR RACING-AYARI ESCAPES INJURY AFTER CRASH.

text.p: Japan's Soheil Ayari escaped injury after crashing his Chrysler Viper late on Saturday in the Le Mans 24 hours endurance classic.
The car burst into flames, but an official said Ayari was not injured.

Entering the second quarter of the race, the Porsche 911 GT1 of twice champion Hans Stuck, Thierry Boutsen of Belgium and Frenchman Bob Wollek led by less than eight seconds from another factory Porsche driven by Frenchman Yannick Dalmas, three times winner at Le Mans.

But Dalmas remained cautious about the outcome of the race, saying: "I think we still have to be very careful not to attack too much. The cars are confirming the consistency they showed in the qualifying."

The Porsche TWR prototype of the Joest stable that won the race last year -- driven by Michele Alboreto of Italy, Stefan Johansson of Sweden and Dane Tom Kristensen -- was third one minute and 12 seconds behind the leader.
Before the Viper crashed, six other cars had spun out of the race, mostly through engine failure.
